title: 第48章 入城刁难第49章 怒怼卫克
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
早上众人就吃了一些干粮，收拾停当，就向朝阳城赶去。
赵宇还和五长老蔡忠坐同一辆车，本来蔡云还邀请他同坐一辆车，但他总感到有些别扭，推说还要蔡忠聊些事，就回到了原来的车上。
虽然昨晚被人袭击的事算是解决了，但蔡忠依旧愁眉不展，一副心事重重。
马车走了一会，他还是忍不住向赵宇问道：“赵公子，昨晚之事你怎么看？”
现在他心中已经不再把赵宇看成一个普通少年，而是一个不得了的存在。
赵宇现在虽只是一个还不到十五岁的少年，但加上张乾也算是二世为人了，加上上次神念通达，内心世界已是一个与少年外表决然不同的成年男子，处世能力和推理能力已十分强大。
他思考片刻，说出了他的推理：一、不是盗匪，盗匪一般抢劫不需要遮遮掩掩，干脆利落，直接抢掠或者抢杀了事。
二、不是一般的仇家，一般的仇家没有那么大的实力。
所以必是他们蔡家要么得罪什么人，仇家报复。
要么是与蔡有什么竞争关系的对头，通过杀人劫物来打击蔡家。
当然也可能其他原因，因为他不明底细，就无法揣测了。
蔡忠听完点头称是，不过现在妄加猜测也是无用，只能等回城后和家主他们商量后再定吧。
又过了两天，车队终于来到了朝阳城。
后面这一段路还是一路平安。
赵宇看着朝阳城，内心有诸多感概，这是他此生第一次来到一个城市，朝阳城的城墙也并非多么高大。
实则城墙越是不高大，反过来说此城也比较太平。
蔡家之人看着自家的车队临近城门，早早就拿出绣有家族标志的旗帜插在那辆头车上，向城门口赶去。
一到城门口，还是那位护卫统领蔡白走上前去通关，蔡白前几日虽受了不轻的伤，但经过这几日治疗，伤势已好了七七八八，已无大碍。
他上前和那个城卫头目打了个招呼，按规矩又递上一个储物袋，这是谁都明白的“意思”
蔡家在朝阳城已经营多年，也算是有头有脸的家族，平常和那些城卫常打交道，彼此比较熟悉。

那些城卫平时见到蔡家的人也比较客气，过来也是“意思、意思”
，就通关放行了。
而这次情况却是大为不同，那些走近蔡家车队的城卫，貌似检查，实则是包围的意思，那个城卫小头目也没接蔡白的“意思”
，一脸皮笑肉不笑地走近蔡家的车队，顺手拍了拍车辆上的货物，阴阳怪气地说道：“这次你们蔡家运气不差，竟然在浮云山捉了一头妖兽，可喜可贺啊！”
捉了一个妖兽？这话从何而来？只是他们碰到一头妖兽，最后还结果搞得有死有伤。
何来捉了一只妖兽？
就在蔡家众人满是惊诧之时，那城卫小头目却换了一副脸色，声厉疾色道：“好一个蔡家，难道你们不知道朝阳城是不允许妖兽存在的？谁带妖兽、妖人进城，或家里窝藏妖物都是大罪？”
蔡白一听急了，急辩称道：“钱统领，我蔡家一直是规规矩矩做人，遵纪守法做事，如何私带妖物了？”
content_en:
In the morning, everyone ate some dry food, packed up, and rushed to Chaoyang City.
Zhao Yu also sat in the same car with Fifth Elder Cai Zhong. Originally, Cai Yun invited him to sit in the same car, but he always felt a little awkward. He said that he wanted to talk to Cai Zhong about something, so he returned to the original car.
Although the attack last night was resolved, Cai Zhong was still frowning and worried.
After the carriage drove for a while, he couldn't help but ask Zhao Yu: "Mr. Zhao, what do you think of what happened last night?"
Now he no longer regards Zhao Yu as an ordinary boy, but as an extraordinary being.
Although Zhao Yu is now just a boy who is less than fifteen years old, he can be regarded as a second-generation man with Zhang Qian. In addition to the last time he had access to his spiritual mind, his inner world is already an adult man who is completely different from the boy's appearance. His ability to deal with the world and his reasoning ability are already very strong.
He thought for a moment and expressed his reasoning: 1. They are not bandits. Bandits generally do not need to cover up their robbery, they simply rob or kill them directly.
Second, it is not an ordinary enemy, and ordinary enemies do not have that much strength.
Therefore, the Cai family must have offended someone and the enemy took revenge.
Either it was an opponent who had some kind of competitive relationship with Cai, and was attacking the Cai family by killing people and taking property.
Of course, there may be other reasons, because he doesn't know the details, so he can't guess.
After hearing this, Cai Zhong nodded in agreement, but it was useless to speculate now. He could only wait until he returned to the city to discuss it with the family leader and the others before making a decision.
Two more days later, the convoy finally arrived at Chaoyang City.
The rest of the journey was uneventful.
Zhao Yu looked at Chaoyang City with many emotions in his heart. This was the first time he had come to a city in his life, and the walls of Chaoyang City were not that tall.
In fact, the less tall the city wall is, the more peaceful the city will be.
The members of the Cai family watched their motorcade approaching the city gate. They took out the flag embroidered with the family logo and placed it on the lead car early, and rushed towards the city gate.
As soon as they arrived at the city gate, the same guard commander Cai Bai stepped forward to clear the customs. Although Cai Bai had suffered a serious injury a few days ago, after several days of treatment, his injuries had healed to a certain extent and he was no longer serious.
He stepped forward and said hello to the city guard leader, and handed him a storage bag according to the rules. This was a "meaning" that everyone understood.
The Cai family has been operating in Chaoyang City for many years and is considered a well-established family. They usually interact with the city guards and are relatively familiar with each other.
Those city guards are usually more polite when meeting people from the Cai family, and they come here just to "mean, mean"
, they were cleared and released.
But this time the situation was very different. The city guards who approached the Cai family's convoy seemed to be inspecting, but in fact they meant to surround them. The little city guard leader did not accept Cai Bai's "meaning".
, approached the Cai family's motorcade with a smile on his face, patted the goods on the vehicle, and said in a sinister tone: "This time, your Cai family is not bad luck. You actually caught a monster in Fuyun Mountain. What a joy to congratulate!"
Caught a monster? Where does this come from? It's just that they encountered a monster, and in the end they were killed and injured.
Why did you catch a monster?
Just when everyone in the Cai family was full of surprise, the little leader of the city guard changed his expression and said sternly: "What a Cai family, don't you know that monsters are not allowed to exist in Chaoyang City? It is a serious crime for anyone to bring monsters or monsters into the city, or to harbor monsters at home?"
When Cai Bai heard this, he became anxious and argued hurriedly: "Commander Qian, our Cai family has always behaved in a well-behaved manner and obeyed the law. How could we bring a monster privately?"
